tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds US companies in the Companies Daily database by name, ticker or SEC CIK: name, CIK, tickers, exchanges, kind of filer, status, city and state, url of the company page. The database holds every listed company and every company with a classified SEC filing since Oct 1, 2026. Details and filing h

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company by CIK or ticker, as on its Companies Daily page: tickers, exchanges, kind of filer, status, state of incorporation, city and state, SIC code, fiscal year end, last annual and quarterly report, Form D offering figures, XBRL totals, “What this means” notes (facts from filings, no judgement

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Revenue, net income, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders’ equity and cash from the XBRL data a company filed with the SEC, by calendar-year frame (up to 3 years), in US dollars.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Classified SEC filings of US companies (bankruptcies, debt defaults, delisting notices, late filings, restatements, leadership changes, IPOs, Form D raises, annual and quarterly reports…) filtered by type, day or date range and state; newest first, with paging. Each item: dates, type, form, 8-K item

tools.name: get_daily_edition
tools.description: What US companies filed with the SEC on one EDGAR business day: companies by event type and full lists of bankruptcies, revocations, debt defaults, delisting notices, late filings and restatements. Without a date: the latest ready edition.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: EDGAR business days with an edition, newest first: state (ready or open), companies with classified filings, bankruptcies, late filings, delisting notices, leadership changes, IPOs, private raises.

tools.name: get_state_summary
tools.description: SEC filings of companies with a business address in one state (or DC): event counts since the start of the data, the latest bankruptcies and delisting notices, late filings, raises and IPOs, leadership changes, and cities with a page.

tools.name: list_event_types
tools.description: Values for the filters: 22 event types (key, list slug, label, url of the list) and the 50 states and DC (slug, USPS code, url).

tools.name: list_followed_companies
tools.description: Needs sign-in (OAuth, scope watchlist:read). The companies the signed-in reader follows on Companies Daily: name, CIK, tickers, status, date of the last filing in an edition, since when followed, url of the company page; and whether email alerts are on.

tools.name: follow_company
tools.description: Needs sign-in (OAuth, scope watchlist:write). Adds a company from the Companies Daily database (by CIK or ticker) to the companies the reader follows, at most 50. When each edition closes, the reader gets one email with the new SEC filings of the followed companies. Use only when the reader asks for

tools.name: unfollow_company
tools.description: Needs sign-in (OAuth, scope watchlist:write). Removes a company (by CIK or ticker) from the companies the reader follows.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies, list_events, list_event_types, list_followed_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company, list_editions, follow_company · Public sink: list_followed_companies, follow_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies, list_events, list_event_types, list_followed_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company, list_editions, follow_company · Public sink: list_followed_companies, follow_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
